findings.finding: The forward-purchase counterparty New Circle holds 4,987,103 ONEN shares it may sell on any day (13D filed overnight 09-30 reserving the right to sell), against roughly 110k shares a day of current turnover ($210k at $1.91), and the FPA gives it no reason to hold: early termination costs it $10.61 a share and the prepayment of ~$53.2m is already paid.
findings.mechanism_in_window: Standing, unrestricted supply that can be sold in the 2026-10-02 session; like an open ATM, it is in the window because nothing blocks it tomorrow. A sale above 1% would also force a 13D/A within two business days.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Since listing on 09-24 the name has fallen on 5 of the 6 post-closing comparable sessions in the baseline (09-23 -22.2%, 09-24 -27.95%, 09-25 -14.0%, 09-28 +21.86%, 09-30 -11.16% next close); the FPA holder has been free to sell throughout.
findings.why_not_priced: The price has taken today's selling, not the unsold balance: 4.99m shares is ~45 sessions of current volume, and the 13D only made the holder and its stated freedom to sell visible overnight. If the market held the full overhang, the stock would have to stop falling on 2.9x volume, which it has not done on 6 of 7 sessions.
